source_migration.proof: Native indexed head uses unchanged constructor/wake/unit_score and direct parameter laws; changed optional lane/race hooks are not called.

initial.scope: Frozen weights; state persists within prescribed windows and resets only for this separately labelled fixed-window diagnostic.

frozen_flagship.scope: Frozen weights; state persists within prescribed windows and resets only for this separately labelled fixed-window diagnostic.

online.state: TRAIN state carries continuously. Last revealed TRAIN target predicts first new DEV target; subsequent DEV targets continue without memory reset.
online.weights: AdamW updates after each32 causally scored targets; both arms eligible

numeric_storage.scope: Numerical native receiver eligibility plus immutable publication inputs/keys/traces and transitive bound parts. Trace bytes may alias current receiver traces;Python metadata,current graphs and credit packets additional. Per-layer root rings bounded;transitive lineage is not constant memory. Additional bounded local producer inputs/frozen write coefficients;current replay graphs/packets are paid. No whole-history replay.

bank_storage.scope: Reserved numeric bank tensors and explicit index counts;Python index/metadata bytes,parameters and credit work additional.

arms.process_scope: Recorded intervals;unsaved interruption tails are not included and no process-cost win is claimed.
arms.scope: One shared acquired checkpoint/seed,paired same-token continuation;pure quality comparison with unequal learning work. FrozenDEV and chronological onlineDEV reported separately;no TEST,public benchmark,iso-FLOP or energy claim. Full arithmetic/special-function/traffic audit incomplete;all measured native work counters and process costs disclosed. Both arms retain legal joint query teacher;only new actual-child content credit differs,so this does not test an exact historical route teacher.
